propositions: Op-cert service currently performs per-job boto3/SSM/region lookups and patches process-global state, creating coupling, concurrency hazards, and cleanup risks.

Key and configuration must be loaded once at startup from exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validated before service initialization, and copied to a process-owned 0700/0600 directory/file.

Both job producer chains (completion via transition_close.sign_completion_verdict and plan-review via generation.sign_manifest) must accept and use a context-local OpcertSigner binding, enabling concurrent job isolation and removing per-job environment patching.
Op-cert application runtime must have no SSM/boto3/region dependency; the key must be materialized by fetch-secrets.sh before container start and bind-mounted read-only with REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH.
Process restarts must observe replacement keys; graceful shutdown removes only Rebar's copy while the deployment source remains untouched.
Developer-local signing paths (close/review-plan without injected binding) must continue resolving via environment variables and genesis defaults for backward compatibility.
